title: Isomorphism inverse image preserves the strict normalized completion chain
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, an isomorphism of schemes $g:X\to Y$, and an arbitrary unbounded complex $P$ of modules over the completed integral coefficient sheaf on $Y$. Let $F$ be the termwise ordinary module pullback. Write $R_Y(P)$ for the strict quotient Roos complex, $u_P:P\to R_Y(P)$ for its quotient-map/zero-second-coordinate augmentation, $T_g(P)$ for the strict pullback quotient Roos complex, and $a_g(P):F(P)\to T_g(P)$ for ordinaryCompletionChain, all as specified in [def-fix-qcqs-completion-ordinary-models, def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. There is a chain isomorphism $e:F(R_Y(P))\xrightarrow{\sim}T_g(P)$ such that $e\circ F(u_P)=a_g(P)$. No goodness, completeness, boundedness, constructibility, qcqs, invertibility of $\ell$, or nonemptiness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Identify the completed direct coefficient map of ordinaryPull with the mate of the projection-normalized sectionwise coefficient isomorphism, by uniqueness of all finite projections. The site adjunction induces a module adjunction whose unit is restriction along its counit. Left-adjoint uniqueness gives an isomorphism ordinaryPull ≅ inverseImageIntegralModules, together with this explicit unit formula.

The slice-none and unrestricted chosen quotient tower presentations are definitionally equal, so the already proved unrestricted insertion_iso gives the tower isomorphism directly, with insertion at every component. The finite augmentation lemma identifies these components after the ordinary/sectionwise module comparison: naturality of the quotient map and finite pullback unit, then the site right triangle, give exactly ordinaryQuotientAugmentation. No Good hypothesis is needed.

Sectionwise inverse image is an additive equivalence, so podReindexingRoosComparison makes the canonical scalarRoosMap invertible for the entire strict quotient tower. Compose with the termwise ordinary/sectionwise comparison and the Roos image of the insertion tower isomorphism. The first mapping-cocone coordinate is the tuple of quotient augmentations by product projection extensionality; the shifted coordinate is zero by the defining scalarRoosMap and Roos-map coordinate formulas. The two cocone coordinates are jointly monic, proving the required augmentation equality.

lean.statement:
theorem isomorphismOrdinaryCompletionChain
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (P : Cx l E Y none) :
    ∃ e : (ordinaryComplexPull l E g).obj ((roos l E Y none).obj P) ≅
        (integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l E g).obj P,
      (ordinaryComplexPull l E g).map (roosUnit l E Y none P) ≫ e.hom =
        ordinaryCompletionChain l E g P
